archetype: Archetype 6: Vibrant Play mixed with Pastel & Soft

headings.usage: Widget header, chat flow titles, welcome message

body.usage: Chat bubbles, quick reply buttons, form inputs

primary.description: Vibrant energetic violet for the main floating button, user chat bubbles, and primary submit buttons.

secondary.description: Bouncy amber/yellow for highlights, icons, and playful accents.

spacing_and_layout.widget_container: fixed bottom-4 right-4 sm:bottom-6 sm:right-6 w-[calc(100vw-32px)] sm:w-[400px] h-[600px] max-h-[80vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl rounded-3xl overflow-hidden bg-white border border-purple-100
spacing_and_layout.form_container: p-4 space-y-4 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-purple-100 mt-2

components.floating_button: h-14 w-14 rounded-full bg-violet-600 text-white shadow-lg hover:bg-violet-700 hover:scale-110 transition-transform flex items-center justify-center
components.quick_reply_button: bg-white border border-violet-200 text-violet-700 hover:bg-violet-50 hover:border-violet-300 rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors text-left
components.form_input: w-full rounded-xl border-purple-200 bg-purple-50/50 focus:border-violet-500 focus:ring-violet-500
components.submit_button: w-full rounded-xl bg-violet-600 text-white font-bold py-3 hover:bg-violet-700

motion.widget_open: spring animation, stiffness 260, damping 20, slightly bouncing up from the trigger button
motion.message_enter: slide up and fade in (translate-y-4 to translate-y-0, opacity 0 to 1)
motion.hover_states: scale-105 for quick replies and buttons

icons.usage: Use Bot for default avatar, X for close, Send for message input, Phone/Calendar/MapPin for forms

image_urls.description: Cute friendly avatar for the chatbot profile. Used as a placeholder until the main Batutynas logo is applied.
Kids jumping on trampoline, used as a rich media card in the welcome message to establish trust and fun.

conversational_flows.label: Vaiko gimtadieniui (Child Birthday)
conversational_flows.flow: Ask for date -> Ask for location/city -> Ask for child age (to recommend size) -> Collect Name & Phone -> Confirm Order

conversational_flows.label: Įmonės renginiui (Company Event)
conversational_flows.flow: Ask for date -> Ask for estimated participant count -> Ask for location -> Collect Company Name, Contact Person, Phone -> Confirm Order

conversational_flows.label: Šventės nuomai (Party Rentals)
conversational_flows.flow: Ask for date -> Ask for location -> Show available options/sizes -> Collect Name & Phone -> Confirm Order

conversational_flows.label: Pirkti batutą (Trampoline Purchase)
conversational_flows.flow: Show sizes (e.g., 3m, 4m) -> Ask for delivery address -> Collect Name & Phone -> Confirm Order

conversational_flows.label: DUK ir Kontaktai (FAQ & Contact)
conversational_flows.flow: Show quick inline FAQ answers (Safety rules, weather policy) -> Show Contact info (Phone, Email) -> Option to escalate

conversational_flows.label: Susisiekti su žmogumi (Talk to human)
conversational_flows.flow: Transition message -> Collect user message -> Notify owner -> Show 'We will get back to you soon' message

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on violet-600 passes WCAG AA. Ensure purple-900 on purple-100 passes.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid (e.g., `data-testid='chat-trigger'`, `data-testid='quick-reply-child_birthday'`, `data-testid='form-submit'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI entirely in React with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.
Implement the widget to be fixed at the bottom right of the screen.
When the widget is closed, show a pulsing violet floating action button with a chat icon.
When open, show a clean header with the 'Batutynas' brand and an avatar.
The first message should be a friendly welcome in Lithuanian, containing a rich image card (use the `welcome_media` image) and the 5 quick reply options.
Handle forms directly inside the chat flow using inline structured cards, rather than redirecting away.
For the forms, use clean, large input fields (`rounded-xl`, `bg-purple-50/50`) to feel modern and accessible.
Integrate Shadcn primitives (Input, Button, ScrollArea) but customize them heavily with the rounded, bouncy, violet theme described above.
Ensure all text is strictly in Lithuanian as requested by the user.
Avoid standard center-aligned boring lists. Use bento-style or staggered grids for selecting items like trampoline sizes.
Simulate the email notification/escalation in the backend via FastAPI, and store the conversation/order in MongoDB.
